rule: A project may be called autonomous only when its VPS/local executor can persist state, execute the next allowed step, verify the result, select the next safe step, recover idempotently after restart, and emit a machine-readable receipt without a ChatGPT or zCloud worker.

ftmo.next_step: generation closure automatically activates the next append-only chronological generation

haxlab.contract_status: implemented; verify each release with a live generation-transition receipt
haxlab.next_step: evaluation/promotion or rejection automatically schedules the next generation

ulab.contract_status: requires an explicit runnable workload; no artificial compute
ulab.next_step: queued compatibility jobs run with bounded concurrency and release resources

zssh.contract_status: must receive an autonomy design before recurring build/test work is labelled autonomous

cloud.contract_status: scheduler may route only genuine AI-required work; it must never replace local deterministic executors
